description: This file defines the 'PurgeCandidateAPI' class, which provides REST API endpoints for purging candidate data related to a vacancy and listing purgeable candidates. It includes methods for deleting candidate data and retrieving a list of candidates eligible for purging, with validation and request parameter handling.

classes.name: PurgeCandidateAPI
classes.description: API class providing endpoints to purge candidate data and retrieve list of candidates eligible for purging, specific to certain vacancies.

methods.name: getPurgeService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of PurgeService used for purging candidate data.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to purge candidate data associated with a specified vacancy ID, returning the result as a resource.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the delete operation, ensuring the vacancy ID is positive and exists.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list candidates eligible for purging for a specific vacancy, with sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the GET operation, including vacancy ID and sorting/pagination parameters.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Throws not implemented exception, as create operation is not supported.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Throws not implemented exception, as create operation is not supported.
